item.title: Heavy damage reported in Steubenville house fire
item.description: STEUBENVILLE, Ohio (WTRF) — Fire crews responded overnight to a house fire on Terrace Ave., according to Steubenville Fire Chief Joe Ribar. item.description: The FDA approved the first lab-grown meat product in 2023. According to a report from the Good Food Institute in 2024, $3.1 billion has been invested in the lab-grown meat industry.
